children: posted annual net inflows in line with market views but narrowly missed profit expectations on Monday, even as investors bet on emerging-market assets to diversify their portfolios amid rising geopolitical uncertainty.
Emerging markets have grown steadily from a slowdown, delivering stable returns despite geopolitical uncertainty and volatile oil prices.
The company posted pretax profit of £126.9 million ($171.49 million) for the year ended June 30, below the company-compiled analyst estimate of £128.2 million.
Its annual net inflows of $2.7 billion came in line with market expectations.
